input.plan:
# Medium-Impact Workflow Optimization Plan

## Goal and scope
Implement the prior audit’s medium-priority items (`M1`, `M2`, `M3`) to reduce context load and improve agent efficiency without changing gameplay behavior.

Primary targets:
- `M1`: unify QA command/process references to one canonical command source.
- `M2`: consolidate bot-playthrough technical detail to canonical bot docs.
- `M3`: split scene-dialogue monolith into per-arc files with a lightweight index.

## Canonical source design (post-change)

```mermaid
graph TD
  governanceRule[GovernanceRule] --> aiDocs[AI_DOCS]
  qaSkill[QASkill] --> qaRubric[QARubricPlaytestMode]
  aiDocs --> qaRubric
  qaRubric --> botReadme[BotREADME]
  sceneSpec[SceneAgentSpec] --> scenesIndex[ScenesIndexTOC]
  scenesIndex --> arcFiles[ScenesArcFiles]
  layoutPlanner[LayoutPlannerFallback] --> scenesIndex
```

## Implementation steps

1. **Normalize QA documentation hierarchy (`M1`)**
   - Keep full command list and playtest gate semantics only in [AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md).
   - Trim duplicate command blocks from [AI_DOCS.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_DOCS.md) §11–§12 into concise policy pointers (aliases, opt-in rule, confidence expectation, and “see rubric §Playtest-mode for exact commands”).
   - Trim duplicate command blocks from [SKILL.md](.cursor/skills/axel-simulated-qa/SKILL.md) to pointer-style references to rubric sections, while preserving invocation names, output format requirements, and persistence invariants.
   - Ensure path references in skill/docs point to current canonical locations (`plans/core/*`, `plans/qa/*`).

2. **Consolidate bot-playthrough detail ownership (`M2`)**
   - Keep low-level bot execution/input-pipeline details in [README.md](AXEL/axel_project/test/bots/README.md).
   - In rubric and AI docs, keep only gating-level summaries + links to bot README; remove repeated architecture prose where it duplicates README.
   - Preserve confidence-tier semantics and skip-policy behavior in rubric (no behavior contract change).

3. **Split scenes monolith into arc files (`M3`)**
   - Create a short TOC/index at [AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/scenes/AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md) that links to new arc files.
   - Create per-arc files (initially Arc 1–8) under `AXEL/axel_project/plans/scenes/`, e.g.:
     - `AXEL_SCENES_ARC1.md` ... `AXEL_SCENES_ARC8.md`
   - Move existing content arc-by-arc from the current monolith into those files with no dialogue edits (structure-only refactor).

4. **Update scene agent and tooling references for split docs**
   - Update source references in [SCENE_BUILDER_AGENT_SPEC.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/scenes/SCENE_BUILDER_AGENT_SPEC.md) to the new TOC + arc-file pattern.
   - Update fallback scene-text loading in [layout_planner.py](AXEL/axel_project/tools/scene_builder/layout_planner.py) so it resolves from `plans/scenes/` TOC/arc files rather than a single monolith assumption.
   - Keep canonical filename invariant logic untouched; only update where scene-text discovery path is sourced.

5. **Validation and regression checks**
   - Run repo-wide searches to verify obsolete duplicated command blocks and outdated scene-doc path assumptions are removed.
   - Validate docs still preserve required invariants (QA opt-in, skip policy, persistence requirements, canonical aliases).
   - Smoke-check scene-builder planner path resolution logic after refactor (no canonical filename regression).

6. **Governance bookkeeping**
   - Append one implementation entry to [AI_CHANGELOG.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md) documenting hierarchy decisions and file moves.

## Acceptance criteria
- QA exact command set is authoritative in one place: [AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/qa/AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md).
- [AI_DOCS.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_DOCS.md) and [SKILL.md](.cursor/skills/axel-simulated-qa/SKILL.md) retain behavior policy but use pointer-style references instead of full duplicated command specs.
- Bot implementation detail is owned by [README.md](AXEL/axel_project/test/bots/README.md), with rubric/docs linking to it.
- [AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/scenes/AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md) becomes a compact TOC and arc content lives in arc files.
- Scene agent spec + planner references resolve correctly to split scene docs.
- Changelog records the implementation and conflict-resolution basis (AI_DOCS hierarchy).

Consolidate bot low-level detail into bots README and trim duplicated prose elsewhere.
Split AXEL_SCENES_NEW into Arc1-Arc8 files and reduce original file to TOC.
Update scene agent spec and layout_planner fallback to new scenes docs structure.

```bat
tools\cmd\godot.cmd --headless --path AXEL/axel_project -s res://combat/test/item_balance_audit.gd
```

- Runs paired Monte Carlo simulations (same seeds, no-item baseline vs each equipped item).
- Outputs `ITEM_BALANCE_JSON` line with per-item metrics: delta RTP, encounter success delta, hit-rate delta, avg payout delta, 95% confidence interval, and a classifier label (`overpowered` / `neutral` / `underpowered` / `insufficient_data`).
